project.name: Bballedu
project.identity: Court Vision, a free web-first basketball IQ training platform that teaches users through Player, Coach, and GM lenses.
project.audience: Casual basketball fans first, with a path for players, coaches, analysts, and front-office-minded learners.
project.core_loop: Learn a concept, apply it in film or simulation, reflect on the process and uncertainty, and choose the next lesson.
project.north_star: Users genuinely improve their basketball understanding through explanation-first practice rather than surface entertainment.
not_this: A fantasy basketball or debate-first social product
A native mobile app in the current release boundary
A claim that open browser and live-account verification are complete

mvp.definition: The web learning loop offers structured lessons, representative interactions, and an explanation-first simulator capstone across the three role lenses.

complete_product.definition: Learning, daily engagement, progress, draft and offseason capstones, persistence, and admin content operations are usable and verified in the intended web environment.

outcomes.name: A learner can move from a structured lesson into an interaction or simulation and receive an explanation-oriented result.

layers.intended: Court Vision prioritizes basketball IQ education across Player, Coach, and GM lenses.
layers.planned: The project plan defines lessons, film, pause-and-predict interactions, scenarios, and capstones.
layers.implemented: The repository records implementation through Phase 08 with existing simulator foundations.
layers.verified: Browser/manual verification for the lesson and admin rollout remains open.

evidence.note: Product vision, learning loop, and implementation snapshot.
Current product areas and learning loop.

blockers.summary: Browser/manual QA for the lesson and admin rollout is still required.

outcomes.name: A learner can complete and resume an explanation-first draft or offseason capstone without losing the intended process evidence.

layers.intended: Draft and offseason simulations are planned as final-exam capstones for the learning system.
layers.planned: The project plan requires save/resume, shared stat pipelines, and post-run explanation.
layers.implemented: The repository contains simulator foundations and in-flight data/model work.
layers.verified: Live Supabase validation for account-upgrade continuity and second-device sync remains open.

evidence.note: Phased execution record and remaining gates.

blockers.summary: Live persistence and second-device continuity are not yet established as verified product behavior.

drift.summary: The implementation snapshot is advanced, but lesson/admin browser QA and live persistence continuity remain open product evidence gaps.

evidence.note: Open items are explicitly described as verification-oriented.
